arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
echo "SUPERVISOR_VPS_READINESS"
id -un
if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then echo "SUDO_NONINTERACTIVE=AVAILABLE"; else echo "SUDO_NONINTERACTIVE=UNAVAILABLE"; fi
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null; then echo "SYSTEMD=AVAILABLE"; else echo "SYSTEMD=ABSENT"; fi
echo "SERVICE_CANDIDATES"
systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-pager --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'project.leader|supervisor|codex|telegram' || :
echo "TIMER_CANDIDATES"
systemctl list-unit-files --type=timer --no-pager --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'project.leader|supervisor|codex|telegram' || :
echo "PRESENT_DEPLOY_PATHS"
for p in /home/ubuntu/VPS /root/VPS /opt/VPS /srv/VPS /home/ubuntu/Project-leader-codex /home/ubuntu/project-leader-codex /root/project-secrets /home/ubuntu/project-secrets /root/.config; do
  if test -d "$p"; then printf 'DIR_PRESENT=%s\n' "$p"; fi
done
echo "PYTHON_MODULES"
python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
for m in ("requests","httpx","psutil"):
 print("MODULE_%s=%s"%(m, bool(importlib.util.find_spec(m))))
PY
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-readiness.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/vps"
cd "$tmp/vps"
echo "SUPERVISOR_ENTRYPOINT"
sed -n '325,442p' ops/supervisor_live.py | sed -E 's/(token|secret|password|key)=.*/\1=<redacted>/' | head -n 125
echo "CLOUD_WORKFLOW_STEPS"
sed -n '1,105p' .github/workflows/cloud-supervisor-observation.yml | sed -E 's/(token|secret|password|key)=.*/\1=<redacted>/'
echo "SUPERVISOR_DEPENDENCIES"
grep -R -n --include='*.py' -E 'import (requests|httpx|telegram)|from (requests|httpx|telegram)|TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN|TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID|GITHUB_TOKEN|GH_TOKEN|STATE_HOME|STATE_DIR|SUPERVISOR' ops/supervisor_live.py ops/supervisor_cloud_source.py ops/telegram_gateway.py | sed -E 's/(=).*/=<suppressed>/' | head -n 48
echo "READINESS_FINISHED"
